1.note: Controlled remount with empty value under a persistent Field.Root keeps data-filled.

claims.quote: `data-filled` is never cleared when a control mounts with an empty controlled value under a persistent `Field.Root`

known_problems.reason: States that data-filled stays set for an empty controlled value on remount (the wrong filled state) and explains the mount effect now only calls setFilled(true) with the removed valueProp === '' branch gone; this is exactly GT-r2 trigger (1).

claims.notes: Source check: FieldControl.tsx lines 99-103 mount effect only calls setFilled(true) when inputRef value is truthy; useValueChanged does not fire on mount. The merge-base branch set filled false for valueProp === ''. So the remount case (key flip to empty) leaves data-filled. Matches GT-r2.
evidence: clone/packages/react/src/field/control/FieldControl.tsx lines 99-115: mount effect only sets filled true; useValueChanged runs on change only.

evidence: clone/packages/react/src/field/control/FieldControl.test.tsx:47 test 'renders once per keystroke for controlled input changes' (no validationMode, no validate).
